title: 8 Wicked Wings, 2 Reg Chips, 2 Sauces $10 Pickup @ KFC (Online or App)
body:
Deal: 8 Wicked Wings, 2 Reg Chips, 2 Sauces $10 Pickup @ KFC (Online or App)

[Wiadro] crap deal.
wicked wings are like 80% bone
[whyisave] Tell me you don't know how to enjoy bone, without telling me you don't enjoy bone.
[whyisave] I didn't neg you, but you're missing out …
on that marrow
… and looking after your heart.
[Wiadro] @whyisave: my heart is full of meaty goodness ;)
[Typical16-bitEnjoyer] "Shout a mate"
Lol no one is sharing this between 2, be honest.
[AdModnar] isn't one chip, a sauce, and 4 wings enough for you?
[AdModnar] @Wiadro: ok, so you have 2 chips each with a sauce….
[Alley Cat] Why would you want this when you can get the $6 wicked wings lunch deal? Unless that’s been canceled?
[sleet] How much is the 6 wicked wings lunch deal?
[SkyeMG] You mean the 6 wicked wings and chips for $10 lol.
There is no $6 wicked wings lunch deal?
[node modules] Previous deal worked well on first date. Will try this for second date.
[YoursTruly] 8 Wicked Wings
Yup, clipped for enjoyment from the numerous clones of the 4 wicked chicken sisters: Clucker, Eggatha, Breasta and Thaila.
[bird380] Better value than last week McDonald’s $14.95 for 20 mcnuggets + 2 medium fries
[SkyeMG] Man some of the old mcdonalds monopoly deals were crazy, like 24 nugget and other stuff under $15 probably too
[MrZ] Not really 8 wings, more like 4. Each "wing" they sell is really only 1/2 of a wing. A full "wing" comprises a drumette and wingette/tip.
